I appreciate your effort, Mary, but I'm concerned that being surprised at the party might cause me anxiety and discomfort. Even with a promise of it being stress-free, the unpredictability still makes me uneasy.

I understand your concern, Jane, and I assure you that every detail will be tailored to make sure you feel comfortable and at ease. target: Absolutely, Jane. A surprise party, especially one with your closest friends, will highlight how cherished you are and let you feel the warmth of everyone's love and appreciation.
